description:
`changes/prototype/v1`: what makes a change a prototype, the question it
answers and its verdict.

It lives at `/changes/<name>/prototype`, beside its change. A prototype
works on branch `proto/<name>` and never lands.

question.description: The one question the prototype answers.

verdict.description: What it found, in one sentence.

verdict_artifact.description: The page of the artifact version the verdict means.

title: PrototypeRecord
